sections.title: Independent Editorial Citation — Stefan Loose Reiseführer Indonesien

blocks.body_md:
The Stefan Loose Indonesien travel guide names the founder by name on page 287, in the Ijen-Massiv section — an independent editorial citation in a widely distributed German-language travel guide, predating PT formalization.

- **ISBN:** ISBN-13 9783770167654 (ISBN-10 3770167651)
- **Page:** 287 — Ost-Java / Ijen-Massiv

This is a non-paid editorial listing. Publication year and edition are not asserted.

---

**Detik.com · 14 March 2021**

> "Suka Duka Polisi Pariwisata Bondowoso: Tegakkan Prokes Sambil Lawan Dingin"

Independent reporting on the Tourist Police unit active at Ijen crater — identifying the founder by rank (Bripka) and role in a third-party editorial context. [Read article](https://news.detik.com/berita-jawa-timur/d-5492690/suka-duka-polisi-pariwisata-bondowoso-tegakkan-prokes-sambil-lawan-dingin)

**Radar Jember (Jawa Pos) · 24 March 2021**

> "Polpar Dibentuk untuk Mendukung Ijen Geopark"

Regional press coverage of the Tourist Police formation, explicitly framing JVTO's operational context within the Ijen UNESCO Geopark initiative. [Read article](https://radarjember.jawapos.com/bondowoso/791102263/polpar-dibentuk-untuk-mendukung-ijen-geopark)

sections.title: Third-Party Award — Booking.com Guest Review Award 2015

blocks.body_md:
An independently calculated guest review award issued by Booking.com to the guesthouse operated at Jl. Khairil Anwar 102A, Bondowoso — the same address JVTO operates from today. The original shipping label confirms the delivery address, establishing unbroken address continuity from the 2015 guesthouse era to the current PT registration.

- **Score:** 9.4 / 10
- **Year:** 2015
- **Issued to:** Jl. Khairil Anwar 102A, Bondowoso
- **Issuer:** Booking.com (independent platform)
- **Evidence:** Plaque + original shipping label (2 artifacts)
